news.title: GCA Launcher 3.0 Preview Tour
news.summary: Explore a modernized single screen launcher by GocalSD.
news.content: We are thrilled to announce GCA Launcher 3.0 Open Beta! I will officially launch v3 in 2027 with a subscription model to pro features. If you havn't been keeping an eye on my social feed, get caught up on whats new in GCA with this tour I provided on Youtube.

news.title: GCA v3 Test Video
news.summary: View a test session of v3
news.content: This was one of my first visual test videos coming out to the public for GCA v3. We show off some of the homescreen interactions and Groups 2.0

news.title: Watch for updates
news.summary: Always install new updates when they become available.
news.content: Even tho I have been personally testing GCA Launcher for about 3 months now and you guys for about a week, we are not done with development. New bugs and issues are discovered every day and that is why the flood gates were opened, stay up to date! Bugs are easier to track if we are all on the same version.

news.title: XDA Forums Discussion
news.summary: The forums are back up and running again
news.content: Use the forums as a place for discussion, development request and just honest feedback. The future is being developed for all of us. Let's make android fun again!

news.title: Development Update
news.summary: When is our next beta update?
news.content: I'm sure your eager to get your hands on the next beta update but il be spending the next week or so on this build so expect a new release before Thanksgiving.
